messages:
Maya (AE): Customer inbound: they need CAIQ-level answers for BCP/DR. Key asks: RTO/RPO by deployment type, backup cadence, failover classification (hot/warm/cold), and a sanitized drill log.
Arjun (SE): I can draft. Quick clarification: do they want service-level numbers (SLA) or operational targets (SLO)? Sometimes SIG wants both.
Maya (AE): SIG asked for both — SLA statement + evidence of operational tests. They also asked whether in-flight streaming sessions are recoverable.
Noah (Security): Important: for CAIQ we should be explicit about limitations. For streaming: no guaranteed RPO for active WebSocket streams; we describe session rehydration behavior and best-effort token replay. Also include control refs: BC-01 (DR planning), CP-02 (backups), CM-04 (key mgmt).
Tess (SRE): Ops summary to include:
- Hosted API: SLA 99.9% region; SLO target 99.93% rolling 90d. RTO (regional outage): target 60 minutes to restore API path via failover. Observed typical detection-to-restore ~40-70m in drills. RPO: 5 minutes for persisted KV/prefix caches; streaming sessions best-effort, checkpoint every 2m for important sessions. Backups: continuous incremental snapshots (5m cadence) + daily full config export. Retention: snapshots 30 days, export 90 days.
- Dedicated: Contract SLA typically 99.95%. RTO target 30m for pool-level failover, RPO configurable to customer (default 1-15m). Backups: customer data snapshots to customer S3; supports CMKs.
- Private/on-prem: we ship runbook + tooling, RTO/RPO depend on customer infra; recommend warm standby topology.
Arjun (SE): I'll add brief definitions so SIG reviewers don't misinterpret:
- Hot: active replicas in sync, near-zero RTO.
- Warm: standby with recent snapshots, RTO minutes to an hour depending on cache rehydrate.
- Cold: cold backups, RTO hours to days.
Maya (AE): They want a sample sanitized drill log. Can we produce one with numbers but no IDs?
Tess (SRE): Yes. Example (sanitized):
```
Drill: regional failover exercise - 2026-01-18
Scope: simulate AZ+region API outage for hosted customers
Detection: 00:12 (automated healthchecks)
Failover start: 00:14
Traffic routed to secondary region: 00:35
KV rehydrate complete: 00:44
Service confirmed healthy: 00:50
Total RTO observed: 38 minutes
RPO observed: 4 minutes (some in-flight streaming sessions lost tail; session tokens reissued)
Follow-up: caching optimization and early detection tuning; full postmortem attached (redacted)
```
Noah (Security): For CAIQ text, we should add encryption notes: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit, KMS support with customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private. Also mention quarterly DR exercises and access controls for runbook edits (IAM + approval workflow).
Arjun (SE): I'll draft the CAIQ responses and include Tess's drill snippet. Also adding a short note clarifying "observed RPO" vs guaranteed RPO.
DeployBot: uptime (last 90d): 99.89% — status redwood.statuspage.io/summary
Maya (AE): Awesome. ETA for draft?
Arjun (SE): I'll push a first draft to the thread and attach a redacted postmortem by EOD PT.
Maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll loop the buyer once draft is ready. :white_check_mark:
